exceptions.reason: Tagged documentation and examples corroborate names and behavior but are not independent component-family records.
No duplicate first-level source family remained after normalization; compound files stay inside their owning family.
No first-level family in the locked source snapshot was classified as an experimental-only family; later evidence must create an explicit record.
Generated and curated glyph constants are asset infrastructure, not one component family per icon; the Icon family remains in the normalized catalog.
Base classes, state containers, and utilities are relationship evidence unless a later review finds a distinct public product obligation.
Browser interop and JavaScript assets express host capabilities and renderer implementation, not portable component-family identity.
Localization resources and services are cross-cutting infrastructure rather than a visual component family.
No first-level family was removed from the normalized closure as obsolete; obsolete nested types remain source evidence pending record-level need.
Registered browser, dialog, localization, popover, resize, scroll, and related services are capability/infrastructure evidence, not extra visual families.
Tests and test-only components provide behavioral evidence but do not create public catalog identities.
Themes, tokens, and styles are shared visual infrastructure; ThemeProvider remains a normalized component family.
No source-family coverage question remains unresolved in this version; Phase 4 product dispositions intentionally remain unresolved on family records.
